headline: WHITE HOUSE 🏛️ RESTORES 📲 Media 🍆 ACCESS 🔓 After JUDGE'S ⚖️ ORDER!!
text:
WHITE HOUSE 🏛️ just got ORDERED 📜 by the judge ⚖️ to UNFOLD 🙇‍♂️ and let CNN 📺 Politico 📰 and MS NOW 📡 back into the press 🗣️ pen 🐷 after they got booted 🚫 by Trump 🍊 for that FAKE 🥸 NEWS 📝 beef 🥩!! Betsy Klein 📰 from CNN was straight up DENIED 🚫 entry 🚪 on Thursday 🗓️ while some staff got YEETED 🏌️ out but then the emergency hearing 🆘 hit and BOOM 💥 the badges 🏷️ started flowing again like warm 🍑 honey 🐝!! The outlets filed papers 📑 accusing the administration 🏛️ of REPEATEDLY 🔄 violating the judge's 📜 order to lift the ban 🚫 and yeah the White House clapped back 🗣️ saying they began REINSTATING 🔄 access at 09:00 EDT 🕘 sharp!! "We got our constitutional due process RIGHTS 🛡️ respected" basically screamed the joint statement 📢 from the three outlets while they chased that legal 🍆 action to stop the government from deciding what the press 🗞️ reports!! Fox News 🦊 NBC 📺 CBS 📻 and ABC all suspended their TV coverage 📺 in SOLIDARITY 🤝 because nobody wants the White House picking favorites 🏆 like some thirsty 🥵 gatekeeper!!

TRUMP 🍊 dropped the ban hammer 🔨 last Friday saying these outlets were writing FICTION 📖 or straight up LIES 🤥 about his administration so by Saturday the badges 🏷️ were CONFISCATED 🛑 and the reporters were left outside the gates 🚪 looking mad 😠 and down bad 🫤!! Judge Timothy Kelly 🧑‍⚖️ ruled in the early hours 🌅 that the ban "likely violated their constitutional due process RIGHTS" 🛡️ so he temporarily lifted it and told them to stop playing games 🎲 with the media 🍆!! The White House filing 📜 claimed passes were restored by 09:07 local time ⏰ and the confiscated badges 🏷️ were ready for pickup at 09:45 which basically means they got edged ⏳ for a bit then finally came 💦 to their senses after the court smackdown 👋!! This whole standoff 🥊 limited some TV coverage 📺 right as Trump 🍊 was welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping 🇨🇳 for that fancy state dinner 🍽️ which is peak awkward 😬 timing bro!!

CNN 📺 said some of their journalists including senior White House reporter Betsy Klein 📰 got DENIED 🚫 entry and turned away at the door 🚪 although one producer snuck through 🕵️ while Politico 📰 had a reporter get his press credentials yanked 🛑 and MS NOW 📡 reported that Laura Barrón-López 🗣️ plus a producer were both barred 🚫 with passes taken but another producer slipped in like a ninja 🥷!! All three outlets came out swinging 🥊 accusing the Trump administration of violating their constitutional RIGHTS 🛡️ and they dropped a joint statement 📢 on Monday saying they were pursuing legal action ⚖️ to defend the principle that the government doesn't get to decide what the press reports 📰!! More than 50 media organizations across the spectrum filed an amicus brief 📑 in support including Fox News 🦊 New York Times 🗞️ Washington Post 📝 and Wall Street Journal 📈 because even the rivals know this ban 🍌 was cooked 👨‍🍳!!

PREVIOUS ADMINISTRATIONS have tried similar 🍆 moves like when the Obama White House 🏛️ attempted to exclude Fox News 🦊 from a specific press pool interview back in 2009 🗓️ but after the other four networks in the pool threw a fit 😤 and objected hard Fox News was let back in 🏠!! The current mess started when Trump 🍊 first announced he was barring CNN 📺 MS NOW 📡 and Politico 📰 from the White House grounds claiming national security 🛡️ as the later excuse after initially yelling about FAKE NEWS 📰!! The standoff created this weird limbo 🪢 where some staff were turned away at the gate 🚪 while others got through creating chaotic 🍿 coverage of the Xi Jinping visit 🇨🇳 and that upcoming state dinner 🍷 which honestly left everyone side-eyeing 👀 the whole process!! In the end the judge's order ⚖️ forced the restoration and now the badges 🏷️ are back where they belong so the press 🗞️ can keep doing their job without the administration acting like a jealous ex 💔!!

EVERYONE 🫂 from the networks to the random bystanders knows this was a wild ride 🎢 of constitutional edging ⏳ that ended with the White House finally UNFOLDING 🙇‍♂️ and handing over those restored passes at 09:07 sharp ⏰ after the court said the ban likely violated due process RIGHTS 🛡️!! The outlets kept their receipts 📜 showing repeated violations and the amicus brief from over 50 organizations proved the whole industry was united 🤝 against the Trump 🍊 ban that started last Friday with accusations of "fiction or lies" 📖!! Even though some producers slipped in 🕵️ the main reporters like Betsy Klein 📰 Laura Barrón-López 🗣️ and that Politico guy got their credentials confiscated 🛑 leading to the emergency hearing that flipped the script 📜 and got everyone back inside before the big state dinner 🍽️ kicked off!! This isn't the first time an administration tried to play favorites 🏆 but the judge's swift ruling ⚖️ made sure the press pen 🐷 stayed open for business and the coverage 📺 didn't miss a beat after the initial YEET 🚀!!
